title: Auditable agentic AI for evidence-grounded thyroid ultrasound diagnosis and reporting
abstract: arXiv:2608.12590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Thyroid ultrasound diagnosis requires coordinated lesion localization, measurement, risk stratification and reporting, yet most AI systems address these tasks in isolation and provide limited support for clinical review. We present ThyroidXAgent, a clinician-interactive agentic AI system that coordinates specialized diagnostic tools and stores their outputs as an auditable case-level evidence record. The system was developed using OpenThyroidDB, a multicentre, multitask resource integrating approximately 0.3 million ultrasound images and 24,000 paired reports, and was evaluated on 28,458 non-overlapping test cases, including 8,721 cases from 35 centres in the private NHC-MISD-TUS cohort. Across heterogeneous datasets, ThyroidXAgent achieved a mean Dice score of 87.21 percent for nodule segmentation and a mean AUROC of 0.9466 for benign-malignant classification. translated_title: 可审计的智能体AI用于基于证据的甲状腺超声诊断与报告
translated_abstract: 甲状腺超声诊断需要协调的病灶定位、测量、风险分层和报告，但大多数AI系统孤立地处理这些任务，并为临床审查提供的支持有限。我们提出了ThyroidXAgent，一种临床医生交互式智能体AI系统，它协调专门的诊断工具，并将其输出存储为可审计的病例级证据记录。该系统使用OpenThyroidDB开发，这是一个多中心、多任务资源，整合了约30万张超声图像和24,000份配对报告，并在28,458个非重叠测试病例上进行了评估，其中包括来自35个中心的8,721例私有NHC-MISD-TUS队列病例。在异质数据集上，ThyroidXAgent在结节分割方面实现了87.21%的平均Dice分数，在良恶性分类方面实现了0.9466的平均AUROC。相同的工作流支持淋巴结转移预测和滤泡性病变评估。
tldr: 本文提出ThyroidXAgent，一个可审计的智能体AI系统，通过协调多任务诊断工具并生成病例级证据记录，在甲状腺超声诊断中实现了高精度分割与分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ThyroidXAgent, an auditable agentic AI system that coordinates multi-task diagnostic tools and generates case-level evidence records, achieving high segmentation and classification performance in thyroid ultrasound diagnosis.
